text:
Kate: kicking off rollout of slice-6 now — canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. ETA ~18m. I'll ping when canary green. cc @marta @josh

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: service=runtime slice=slice-6 id=deploy-2971234567

Josh: I'll watch latency dashboards (p95/p99) and error-rate. If p99 > 350ms or 5xx spikes, I'll flag. Also watching token-cost anomalies.

Marta: I'll run the quick smoke scripts once canary finishes: `scripts/smoke_fast.sh --target=slice-6` — should be <30s.

Priya: Noted. I'm on standby for rollback. If rollback needed, I'll trigger `deploy rollback 2971234567` and notify infra.

Kate: Canary finished, no failures in 2 mins. Handing to Marta for quick checks.

Marta: smoke done — core path passes, embeddings service timed out once (120ms) but retried fine. Logs: ```ERROR fetch-embed timeout 120ms -> OK on retry```

Josh: Metrics look steady — errors 0.02% and p99 280ms. No action.

Priya: Ready for gradual ramp. I set the autoscale threshold to 85% for the next 20m. Rollback command staged.

Alex (ops): leaving a tiny hotfix note — routing rule A had a transient 502 during smoke, but upstream probe recovered. Tracing shows timeouts in lb->worker; opened ticket #INFR-4312.

Kate: proceeding to 50%. Please thumbs up when you see green in your dashboards :thumbsup:

Josh: green on tracing and p95 under target. :thumbsup:

Marta: quick manual check — `curl` against /generate with sample prompt returns expected structured output. Added to QA log.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 50% complete. Next: 100% in 10m unless flags.

Priya: No flags. I'll watch 100% ramp and revert if CPU > 92% for 5m.

Kate: 100% rolled. Closing bakewatch. If anyone sees anomalies in the next 30m ping here. Thanks team. :party_parrot:
